historical_national_process_skeleton.action: Register written requests and acknowledge receipt
Assess whether information is already published, available on request, or exempt
Point requester to already published information
Route other requests to competent internal units
Receive unit response and draft reply
Forward out-of-competence requests and inform requester

historical_skeleton_warning: Paraphrased research notes, not quote-verified claims; current applicability and local execution unverified. Do not feed to executable workflow. No deadlines admitted.
